correctness.rationale: Each T_l is a probability-normalized squared harmonic mean. The degeneracy of distinct sample-edge kernels forces only 3-fold repeated edges and triangles to survive joint third moments. Exact counts yield 4(n-1)/n² times the Gaunt coefficient and an equal-degree 8(n-1)(n-2)d_l/n² contribution. Standard Wigner 3j factorial formula establishes strict parity/triangle selection and all boundary n values. A 1562-assertion packaged checker independently verifies Legendre integrals and exact-design low-degree sample moments; the general proof is analytic.
